executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: DTO constructors changed from parameterized to no-arg (builder pattern), service method signatures require additional userId parameter, type mismatches between long/UUID and Priority/TaskPriority enums, and missing methods in DTOs and data store. These are breaking API changes requiring test code updates to match refactored production code.

errors.message: Constructor TaskCreateRequest/TaskResponse/TaskUpdateRequest cannot accept arguments - requires no-arg constructor
errors.root_cause: DTOs were refactored from parameterized constructors to builder pattern with no-arg constructors. Tests still use old constructor syntax with direct parameter passing.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all DTO instantiations with builder pattern: TaskCreateRequest.builder().title(...).description(...).build()

errors.message: Method createTask requires userId parameter but test provides only TaskCreateRequest
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask() signature changed to require userId as first parameter for user context. Tests call method without userId.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all createTask() calls to include userId: taskService.createTask(

errors.message: Method getUserTasks requires 4 parameters (userId, page, size, sortBy) but test provides only 3 (long, int, int)
errors.root_cause: getUserTasks() signature changed to accept String userId and sortBy parameter. Tests pass long userId and omit sortBy.

errors.message: Method getTaskById requires UUID and userId but test provides only long
errors.root_cause: getTaskById() signature changed to accept UUID taskId and String userId. Tests use long taskId without userId.

errors.message: Method updateTask requires UUID, userId, and TaskUpdateRequest but test provides long and TaskUpdateRequest
errors.root_cause: updateTask() signature changed to require UUID taskId and String userId. Tests use long taskId without userId.

errors.message: Method deleteTask requires UUID and userId but test provides only long
errors.root_cause: deleteTask() signature changed to accept UUID taskId and String userId. Tests use long taskId without userId.

errors.message: Method bulkCreateTasks requires userId and List<TaskCreateRequest> but test provides only Object
errors.root_cause: bulkCreateTasks() signature changed to require String userId as first parameter. Tests omit userId.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: method getCode() in ErrorResponse
errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse DTO no longer has getCode() method. Likely refactored to different field name or removed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check ErrorResponse class for correct getter method name (e.g., getErrorCode() or getStatus()) and update test assertions

errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler no longer has handleValidationErrors() method. Method was renamed or removed during refactoring.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check GlobalExceptionHandler for correct validation error handler method name and update test calls

errors.message: Incompatible types: long cannot be converted to String for userId, Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: Task entity userId field changed from long to String. Priority enum renamed to TaskPriority. Tests use old types.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update Task instantiations: use String.valueOf(userId) and TaskPriority enum instead of Priority

errors.message: Method findByUserId requires 4 parameters (userId, page, size, sortBy) but test provides 3 (long, int, int)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore.findByUserId() signature changed to accept String userId and sortBy parameter. Tests use long and omit sortBy.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: method findAll() and existsById() in InMemoryTaskDataStore
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore no longer has findAll() and existsById() methods. Methods were removed or renamed during refactoring.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check InMemoryTaskDataStore for alternative query methods or implement missing methods if required for testing
